deployResources.requirements: A dedicated Linux Auto Deploy node is recommended: root SSH, systemd + cgroup v2 CPU/memory controllers, and an XFS volume with active uquota + prjquota. Setup installs xfsprogs; it never formats a disk or changes mount options. New deploys stop if prerequisites are missing. 100% CPU means one core; all apps share the budget. Firewall and network isolation also need configuring before public production use.

q2.question: How do I purchase a hosting plan?
